name: Nifty Stopwatch
what: Use: Increases run speed by 40% for 10 sec. (6 Min Cooldown)

name: Skull of Impending Doom
what: Use: Increase your run speed by 60% for 10 sec, but deals 100 to 500 damage and drains 100 to 500 mana every 2 seconds. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Mind Control Cap
what: Use: Engage in mental combat with a humanoid target to try and control their mind. If all works well, you will control the mind of the target for 20 sec ..... (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Net-o-Matic Projector
what: Use: Captures the target in a net for 10 sec. The net has a lot of hooks however and sometimes gets caught in the user's clothing when fired...... (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Rocket Helmet
what: Use: Charge an enemy, knocking it silly for 30 seconds. Also knocks you down, stunning you for a short period of time. Any damage caused will revive the target. (20 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Death Ray
what: Charges with your own health, then fires a big burst at your target.

name: Gnomish Battle Chicken
what: Use: Creates a Battle Chicken that will fight for you for 1.5 min or until it is destroyed. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Arcanite Dragonling
what: Use: Activates your Arcanite Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Mithril Mechanical Dragonling
what: Use: Activates your Mithril Mechanical Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Harm Prevention Belt
what: Use: A shield of force protects you from the next 500 damage done over the next 10 min. WARNING: Force Field may overload when struck temporarily removing the wearer from this dimension. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Gyrofreeze Ice Reflector
what: Use: Reflects Frost spells back at their caster for 5 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Ice Deflector
what: Use: Absorbs 600 frost damage. Lasts 1 min. (15 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Shrink Ray
what: Use: Shrinks the target reducing their attack power by 250. Thats what it usually does anyway..... (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Discombobulator Ray
what: Use: Transforms the target into a Leper Gnome, reducing its melee and spell damage by 40 and its movement rate by 20% for 12 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Bomb Dispenser
what: Use: Creates a mobile bomb that charges the nearest enemy and explodes for 315 to 385 fire damage. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Mortar
what: Use: Inflicts 393 to 531 Fire damage and stuns the targets in a 5 yard radius for 3 sec. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Dragon Gun
what: Use: Deals 66 to 74 Fire damage for 10 sec to all targets in a cone in front of the Engineer. Deals 2 times as much damage to Beasts. That is unless it explodes..... (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Land Mine
what: Use: Places the Goblin Land Mine on the ground. It will explode for 394 to 506 Fire damage the next time a hostile creature passes near it. The mine has a duration of 1 min. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Thorium Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yard radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Iron Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 132 to 218 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yard radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Goblin Sapper Charge
what: Use: Explodes when triggered dealing 450 to 750 Fire damage to all enemies nearby and 375 to 625 damage to you. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Dense Dynamite
what: Use: Inflicts 340 to 460 Fire damage in a 5 yard radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Arcane Bomb
what: Use: Burns 675 to 1,125 mana from those in the blast radius and does 50% of the mana drained in damage to the target. Also Silences targets in the blast for 5 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Hi-Explosive Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 255 to 345 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 3 yard radius for 3 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Flash Bomb
what: Use: Causes all Beasts in a 5 yard radius to run away for 10 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Free Action Potion
what: Use: Makes you immune to Stun and Movement Impairing effects for the next 30 sec. Does not remove effects already on the imbiber. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Living Action Potion
what: Use: Makes you immune to Stun and Movement Impairing effects for the next 5 sec. Also removes existing Stun and Movement Impairing effects. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Limited Invulnerability Potion
what: Use: Imbiber is immune to physical attacks for the next 6 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Swiftness Potion
what: Use: Increases run speed by 50% for 15 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Restorative Potion
what: Use: Removes 1 magic, curse, poison or disease effect on you every 5 seconds for 30 seconds. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Magic Resistance Potion
what: Use: Increases your resistance to all schools of magic by 50 for 3 min. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Greater Stoneshield Potion
what: Use: Increases armor by 2,000 for 2 min. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Mighty Rage Potion
what: Use: Increases Rage by 45 to 75 and increases Strength by 60 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Gift of Arthas
what: Use: Increases resistance to shadow by 10. If an enemy strikes the imbiber, the attacker has a 30% chance of being inflicted with disease that increases their damage taken by 8 for 3 min. Lasts for 30 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Oil of Immolation
what: Use: Does 50 fire damage to any enemies within a 5 yard radius around the caster every 3 seconds for 15 sec (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Demonic Rune
what: Use: Restores 900 to 1,500 mana at the cost of 600 to 1,000 life. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Dark Rune
what: Use: Restores 900 to 1,500 mana at the cost of 600 to 1,000 life. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Brittle Trap
what: Use: Renders a target unable to move for 10 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Mana Bomb
what: Use: Burns 675 to 1,125 mana from those in the blast radius and deals 50% of the mana drained in damage to the target. Also Silences targets in the blast for 5 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Dark Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 225 to 675 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yd radius for 4 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Tru-Trigger Frag Bomb
what: Use: Inflicts 149 to 201 Fire damage and stuns targets in an 8 yd radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yd radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Shafety Sheep
what: Use: Summons an Explosive Sheep which will charge at a nearby enemy and explode for 135 to 165 damage. Lasts for 3 min or until it explodes. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Magnetic Displacer
what: Use: Disrupt a magnetic field between you and your nearby enemy target, knocking you both away. Can only affect targets up to 2 levels higher than you. Some targets cannot be displaced. Targets can only be affected by this effect once every 2 min. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: Potion of Predatory Senses
what: Use: Drink to slightly increase your stealth detection. While you are not moving for 3 sec, nearby moving stealthed enemies may reveal a heat trail. Lasts for 1.5 min. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Stealthman 52
what: Use: Cloaks the user in a stealth field for up to 1 min. Cannot be used in combat. The field lasts for up to 6 sec after moving. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Pop-Up Shrub
what: Use: Deploy an emergency hiding spot. Most enemies will be less likely to notice you while you stand near it. Observant foes may not be so easily fooled. Cannot be cast in combat.

name: Enchant Cloak - Stealth
what: Use: Permanently enchant a cloak to give an increase to your stealth as if you were 1 level higher.

name: Arcanite Reaper
what: Crafted BoE two-hand axe - a classic warrior PvP weapon.

name: Lionheart Helm
what: Crafted BoE plate helm with crit and hit - best-in-slot for many melee.

name: Enchant 2H Weapon - Grand Inquisitor
what: Use: Permanently enchant a two-handed melee weapon so that often when attacking in melee it heals for 350 to 450 and increases Strength by 200 for 20 sec.

name: Enchant 2H Weapon - Grand Arcanist
what: Use: Permanently enchant a two-handed melee weapon so that often when striking with a spell it restores 350 to 450 mana and increases Spell Power by 140 for 20 sec.

name: Anathema
what: Epic priest staff - swap it into Benediction (healing form) and back.

name: Benediction
what: Epic priest staff - holy healing form; swap it into Anathema (shadow form).

name: Goblin Rocket Boots
what: Use: These dangerous looking boots significantly increase your run speed for 20 sec. They are prone to explode however, so use with caution. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Rocket Boots
what: Use: These boots significantly increase your run speed for 20 sec. WARNING: Their power supply and gyros do not always function as intended. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Cloaking Device
what: Use: Gives invisibility for 10 sec. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Nitro Boosts
what: Use: Activate a set of jets to increase your movement speed by up to 160%, for up to 8 sec. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Teleport
what: Use: Teleport forward 20 yds. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: Ultralight Goblin Glider
what: Use: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Disposable Parachute
what: Use: Reduces your fall speed for 10 sec. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Field Transporter: Gadgetzan
what: Use: Safely transport yourself to Gadgetzan in Tanaris! Emphasis on Safe! Yup, nothing bad could ever happen while using this device! (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Emergency Ripper: Everlook
what: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Everlook in Winterspring. There are technical problems that sometimes occur, but that's what Goblin Engineering is all about! (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: EZ and SAF Field Transporter: Mt. Hyjal
what: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: Dimensional Transporter - Mt. Hyjal
what: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: Enchant Boots - Speed
what: Use: Permanently enchant boots to increase movement speed by 8%.

name: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
what: Use: Permanently enchant boots to increase movement speed by 4%.

name: Enchant Gloves - Riding Skill
what: Use: Permanently enchant gloves to grant a minor movement bonus while mounted.

name: Hoof-Shaped Foot Pedal
what: Use: Transform into a centaur for 20 min or until you enter combat. While in Desolace, your movement speed is also increased by 30% and this transformation persists through combat. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Deepdive Helmet
what: Equip: Water breathing lasts 100% longer than normal.

name: Azure Silk Belt
what: Equip: Increases swim speed by 15%.

name: Swim Speed Potion
what: Use: Increases swim speed by 100% for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Lesser Invisibility Potion
what: Use: Gives the imbiber lesser invisibility for 15 sec. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
what: Use: Unfurl a sleeping bag. Resting inside for at least one minute will provide a bonus to experience earned, stacking up to 3 times. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Camp Tent
what: Use: Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Elixir of Endless Experience
what: Use: Increases experience gained by 200% for 1 hour. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Loot-A-Rang
what: Use: Retrieves the loot from a nearby corpse. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Compact Critter Carrier
what: Use: Place a Compact Critter Carrier for 3 min that allows Hunters in your group to access their stabled pets. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Scroll of Reintegration
what: Use: Brings a dead player back to life with 15% of their health and mana. Cannot be used when in combat. (1 Sec Cooldown)

name: Chronoboon Displacer
what: Use: Alters the fabric of time, suspending beneficial world effects from dragonslaying, Dire Maul, Zul'Gurub, and Felwood. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Scroll of Overwhelming Power
what: Use: Grants the target a variety of world buff effects. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Elixir of Coalesced Regret
what: Use: Allows the imbiber to speak with the corpse of an individual with unfinished business in the mortal world. Also may cure indigestion. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Potent Anti-Venom
what: Use: Target is cured of poisons up to level 45. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Surgical Tourniquet
what: Use: Target is cured of bleeds up to level 65. Not usable in combat. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Powerful Poultice
what: Use: Target is cured of diseases up to level 65. Not usable in combat. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Purification Potion
what: Use: Attempts to remove one Curse or Bane, one Disease and one Poison from the Imbiber. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Enchant Gloves - Lotus Claw
what: Use: Permanently enchant a pair of gloves to give a small chance to acquire Death Lotus when gathering any herb in Hyjal.

name: SAF-T Ultra Precision Scope
what: Use: Attaches a permanent scope to a bow, gun, or crossbow that increases its critical strike chance by 2%.

name: Goblin Jumper Cables XL
what: Use: Jumper Cables will sometimes be able to shock a dead player back to life. Cannot be used when in combat. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Universal Remote
what: Use: Allows control of a mechanical target for a short time. It may not always work and may just root the machine or make it very very angry. Gnomish engineering at its finest. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: Noggenfogger Elixir
what: Random: slow fall, turns you into a skeleton, or shrinks you.

name: Savory Deviate Delight
what: Turns you into a pirate or a ninja for an hour.

name: Elixir of Endless Growth
what: Use: Enlarges the imbiber by a significant amount for 10 min. This effect stacks up to 5 times. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Elixir of Giant Growth
what: Use: Your size is increased and your Strength goes up by 8 to match your new size. Lasts 2 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: World Enlarger
what: Enlarges the entire world for 5 min or until you attack. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Centaur Banner Deployment Device
what: Deploy a banner representing your chosen faction in the Desolace centaur war for 5 min. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Blue Firework
what: Use: Shoots a firework into the air that bursts into a thousand blue stars. (1 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flame Deflector
what: Use: Absorbs 500 Fire damage. Lasts 1 min. (15 Min Cooldown)

name: Draught of Water Breathing
what: Use: Allows the Imbiber to breathe water for 30 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)
